summary.name: Saga Feedback
summary.one_liner: A public Canny-powered feedback board where users submit and vote on feature requests for the Saga app's roadmap.
use_cases: Suggest a feature for the Saga app
Check which features are planned or in progress
Track the status of requested improvements
summary.what_it_does: The page is a public feedback board for the Saga team, hosted on Canny, with a Roadmap view and a Feature Requests board. It lists requests such as Kanban View, Offline mode, sortable tables, PDF export, an API, collection sharing, Saga AI search across the workspace, and version history. Each entry shows a vote count and a status, with some marked Planned, In Progress, or Complete (for example, an iOS mobile app is marked Complete). Users can log in to submit feedback and filter the list.
notable: Public roadmap with vote counts and status labels (Planned, In Progress, Complete)
Hosted on Canny, a third-party feedback tool
Lists the Saga app's requested features such as Kanban view, offline mode, and an API
caveats: Page is a feedback board, not the Saga product itself; it does not describe the app's full functionality
Requests listed here are not confirmed to ship; statuses are shown only for some items
